text:
rachel: FYI - spotted ~1.7% of inbound MQLs yesterday that remained ownerless in HubSpot. Router logged 'no-route' after enrichment timed out at ~28s. Putting this here to triage quick fixes.

diego: I replicated the trace. enrichment-worker had a vendor 502 burst + several slow redis GETs. Router currently treats long-pending as non-routable.

infra-bot: Alert: enrichment-worker latency anomaly detected 13:42 UTC (p95=46s).

megan: Are these going to a DLQ or landing in HS without owner? Need to know for SLA breach calc.

rachel: They appear in HS but owner_id is null, so workflows and SDR queues ignore them. Sales flagged 6 missed touches.

oliver: Quick mitigation idea: add a two-tier fallback. First, short-hold for 8s to catch fast enrich. If still pending, assign to overflow_light (no sequences). If enrichment completes inside 90s, reconcile owner and mark hs_handoff_outcome = 'reconciled'.

sasha: +1. Also suggest exposing hs_pending_enrich_ts and hs_handoff_mode fields so bizops can filter and retro-audit.

diego: Implementation notes: feature flag marketing.two_tier_fallback, configable timeouts: short_hold=8s, final_cut=90s. Router will do: check short hold, then assign overflow_light, schedule reconcile job. Need safe owner updates to avoid duplicate outbound triggers.

oliver: Code sketch:
```
if (enrich_pending) {
  if (now - enrich_start < 8s) return 'wait'
  if (now - enrich_start < 90s) {
    assignOverflow('overflow_light')
    setMeta('handoff_mode','overflow_light')
    scheduleReconcile(90s)
  } else {
    return 'no-route'
  }
}
```

tony: HubSpot mapping proposal:
metadata.enrich_start -> hs_pending_enrich_ts
metadata.handoff_mode -> hs_handoff_mode
metadata.reconcile_id -> hs_reconcile_id
Also add hs_no_sequence boolean when handoff_mode starts with 'overflow'

megan: Good. Also track metrics: fallback_rate, reconcile_latency, reconcile_success_rate. Add alert if fallback_rate > 0.5% sustained over 1h.

diego: I'll prototype PR tonight with unit tests for the race where enrichment callback arrives between short_hold and overflow assignment. Will add feature flag gating.

sasha: I'll run a 48h audit and post counts. SQL draft:
```
SELECT count(*), hs_handoff_mode
FROM leads
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '48 hours'
AND owner_id IS NULL
GROUP BY hs_handoff_mode;
```

rachel: Action list: diego (PR + tests + flag), tony (HS mapping + suppression field), sasha (48h audit), oliver (reconcile worker + safe-owner update), megan (metrics + alert).

infra-bot: Incident ticket created: MARKETING-3087654321-fallback-routing.

sasha: Posting audit results in ~30m. Preliminary looks like ~130 leads affected in last 48h.

oliver: One more thought: skip assigning to overflow_light any SDRs marked 'no_overflow' and rotate fairly to avoid hot-spotting. Add overflow_token to round-robin state.

megan: Also update nurture workflows to ignore hs_handoff_mode values starting with 'overflow' so we don't send immediate sequences.

rachel: If we can land the flag + HS mappings by tomorrow morning let's canary overnight and watch fallback_rate + reconcile_success. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
